name: Festival Stone of Darktide
title: Festival Stone of Darktide
summary: One of the Empyrean Festival Stones, on a 34 m-high islet off the west coast near Ayan Baqur (59.7S 90.0W), flanked by two Master's Sentinel statues with its Anniversary glow 8 m above. East of the islet two rows of ruined Empyrean pillars stand in the shallow sea (y 10050 and 10062, x 3005-3054) and a second pillar ring at (2934-2958, 10183-10206); seven of the pillars carry Flames (five in the south-east rows, two in the north-east ring).

landmarks.name: Festival Stone
landmarks.note: With two Master's Sentinel statues 5 m north and south; Anniversary Effect at z 41.7.

shots.standingOrder: Push slowly in from the south on the glowing Festival Stone between its two sentinel statues, the low sun raking from the left; stop 9 m short of the stone and 3 m above the bushes.
shots.notes: Push-in from the south on the Festival Stone between its two Master's Sentinel statues, from 21 m (WS) to 9 m (FS), slightly high (14 deg) so the sea shows beyond; the golden sun (0.80, west-north-west) rakes from the left and rim-lights the stone and its Anniversary glow 8 m above. The nearest 'obstacle' is the 34 m bounding box of the big tree west of the stone (its crown does not reach the lens line). shots.standingOrder: Skim west 2.5 m above the sea between the two rows of flaming Empyrean pillars toward the islet and the low sun; keep 5 m from every pillar and flame.
shots.notes: Signature water and flames: skim 2.5 m above the shallow sea heading west between the two rows of ruined Empyrean pillars (rows 12 m apart at y 10050 / 10062), straight into the low golden sun: the flame-crowned pillars whip past on both sides at t 3-4 and 7-9 (proj.mjs), backlit, with the islet and its Festival Stone ahead. 99 % of samples over water; nearest pillar 4.6 m.
